record.bible_text: <FO><FO>To the chief Musician<WH05329><WTH8764>, <FI>A Psalm<Fi> of David<WH01732>, to bring to remembrance<WH02142><WTH8687>.<Fo><Fo> <FI>Make haste<Fi> , O God<WH0430>, to deliver<WH05337><WTH8687> me; make haste<WH02363><WTH8798> to help<WH05833> me, O LORD<WH03068>. <RF>to help...: Heb. to my help<Rf>

Let them be ashamed<WH0954><WTH8799> and confounded<WH02659><WTH8799> that seek<WH01245><WTH8764> after my soul<WH05315>: let them be turned<WH05472><WTH8735> backward<WH0268>, and put to confusion<WH03637><WTH8735>, that desire<WH02655> my hurt<WH07451>.
Let them be turned back<WH07725><WTH8799> for a reward<WH06118> of their shame<WH01322> that say<WH0559><WTH8802>, Aha<WH01889>, aha<WH01889>.

Let all those that seek<WH01245><WTH8764> thee rejoice<WH07797><WTH8799> and be glad<WH08055><WTH8799> in thee: and let such as love<WH0157><WTH8802> thy salvation<WH03444> say<WH0559><WTH8799> continually<WH08548>, Let God<WH0430> be magnified<WH01431><WTH8799>.

But I <FI>am<Fi> poor<WH06041> and needy<WH034>: make haste<WH02363><WTH8798> unto me, O God<WH0430>: thou <FI>art<Fi> my help<WH05828> and my deliverer<WH06403><WTH8764>; O LORD<WH03068>, make no tarrying<WH0309><WTH8762>.<CM>
